# Multi-frame AX / alarm carrier: original code under `osmem hle threads ax`.
# Setups: AXInit (sead 02762FB4), the JAudio device mixer (0281A1FC construct, 0281A8AC initialize: registers its TV and GamePad
# final-mix callbacks 0281A738 / 0281A81C), the nw::snd remote speaker manager (028A2138 instance, 028A2240 initialize: periodic
# alarm, callback 028A2194). The tested Thread::sleep 02760C3C sleeps 1,000,000 ticks, so frames and alarms fire inside its row.
# The mixer's `active` flag and queued sample buffers are poked for row 02760C3C only (pokes apply after the setups' drain, so
# frame 0 sees them unset): DeviceMixer::accumulate 0281A540's sample loop runs only through the final-mix callbacks inside the
# sleep; accumulate's own row returns at its null-buffer check.
# verify: -strictnan -only 02760C3C,0281A540
src wwhd_src/sead/Thread.cpp wwhd_src/sead/AudioServices.cpp wwhd_src/sead/AudioSystem.cpp wwhd_src/sead/AudioStatics.cpp wwhd_src/sead/HeapRegistryStatics.cpp
src wwhd_src/JSystem/JAudio/JASDeviceMixer.cpp wwhd_src/nw/snd/RemoteSpeaker.cpp
# threadrate=0: this carrier pins the jump-only clock, so axframes_test's exact frame/alarm ticks
# (A4, B2) and firing counts hold; axframes_test B1 also runs it at the default progress clock (rows ok).
osmem hle threads ax threadrate=0
stackfill
fill * 0x5D700000 0x200 0
stable 0x5D700000 0x200
# DeviceMixer at 5D800000 (0x70 bytes), its queued samples at 5D810000; the sleep ticks at 5D820000
fill * 0x5D800000 0x100 0
stable 0x5D800000 0x100
fill * 0x5D810000 0x4000 0x11
stable 0x5D810000 0x4000
field * 5D820000 u32 0
field * 5D820004 u32 1000000
stable 5D820000 8
arg! 02760C3C r3 0x5D820000
arg! 0281A540 r3 0x5D800000
arg! 0281A540 r4 0
setup * 02762FB4 r3=0x5D700000
setup * 0281A1FC r3=0x5D800000
setup * 0281A8AC r3=0x5D800000
# the nw::snd frame driver (028986B0 instance, 02898728 start): its thread 02898F88 registers the app frame callback 02898F64 and waits;
# processFrame 02898AF8 and HardwareVoice::updateAll 028A882C stay mocked (a frame only posts its message)
fill * 0x5D900000 0x4000 0
stable 0x104B7810 0x3CB0
setup * 028986B0
setup * 02898728 r3=0x104B7810 r4=4 r5=0x5D900000 r6=0x4000 r7=1 r8=0
setup * 028A2138
setup * 028A2240 r3=0x104BBE98
# the mixer active with a queued TV and GamePad buffer (after the setups' drain: frame 0 runs with it inactive)
poke 02760C3C 5D800001 u8 1
poke 02760C3C 5D800004 u32 0x5D810000
poke 02760C3C 5D800008 u32 0x2000
poke 02760C3C 5D800014 u32 0x5D812000
poke 02760C3C 5D800018 u32 0x2000
